notes.title: Legacy 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

This is with great news I announce a patch to Sinking Simulator Legacy!

[b]ADDED:[/b]
- Sky colour customization
- Water Colour customization
- The water inside the ships is now transparent

[b]FIXED:[/b]
- A bug preventing the game to close has been patched
- "Grab" tool renamed to "Pull" and its effect is much stronger!
